NER.note: The biometric count is of IDPs in one region, not a population census or household survey.
No national ID enrolment count or share is stated.
Describes IDP registration, not a national ID system.

facts.fact: Niger's humanitarian action minister launched biometric registration of internally displaced people in Diffa region on 20 January 2024, expected to cover about 160,000 people.

systems.owner: Ministry of Humanitarian Action and Disaster Management
